title: Rio Government Uncovers Over R$ 400 Million Misappropriation at Cedae Saúde
seoTitle: Over R$ 400M Misappropriation at Cedae Saúde
subtitle: State audit points to financial irregularities at Cedae's employee healthcare fund.
excerpt: A Rio de Janeiro state audit found evidence of over R$ 400 million in embezzled funds at Cedae Saúde, the company's employee healthcare fund.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
An audit conducted by the Rio de Janeiro state government has uncovered evidence of over R$ 400 million in misappropriated funds at the Cedae Employees' Healthcare Fund (Cedae Saúde).

The investigation reveals that resources intended for employee healthcare were transferred irregularly, raising suspicions of embezzlement exceeding the 400 million reais mark.

State authorities continue to analyze the audit data to determine the next steps regarding Cedae Saúde.

With information from Agência Brasil.
